normal.name: Ombre's Web Log
normal.text: I've finished(?) the Stanley Parable. I've been muling over Stanley and the Narrator and I believe that game is absurdist art. It's the perfect illustration of Camus' "One must imagine Sysiphus happy." To me Stanley is a cog in the machine with a repetitive soul-sucking bullshit job and the game itself is an absurdist tale he's telling himself as a revolt against the Absurd. I looked it up and no one seems to have made the link so maybe I'm spewing bullshit but #videogames #TheStanleyParable
